title: Construction Area — Signage, Lighting, and NAVAID Inspection

footer.manualLine: Visual Aid and Electrical System Maintenance Manual.

items.text: Construction Safety Plan and Phasing Plan approved by Operations Manager and BDCA
All temporary signage: correctly positioned; BCAR- 14 compliant; no conflict with permanent signs
Closed/restricted areas clearly identified by temporary signs
All construction equipment in movement area: marked with high-visibility colors
All construction equipment fitted with amber rotating/flashing beacons
Red and white flags displayed on all airside equipment during daytime
All obstacle lights on construction equipment and temporary structures — functional (verified at night)
Obstacle lighting clearly defines: work limits, access routes, and obstacle locations
No unauthorized equipment within ILS or other NAVAID critical areas
CNS/ATM unit notified of all work near NAVAID critical areas
All temporary lighting systems tested before use — satisfactory operation verified
Temporary lighting: color, intensity, and spacing comply with BCAR-14 and ICAO Annex 14
NOTAMs coordinated and issued for all affected systems — Reference: ___________
Displaced permanent lights replaced by temporary lighting of equivalent function
Construction area perimeter clearly marked and barricaded
All deficiencies corrected prior to resumption of operations

validationRules: Every item marked NOSAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Item codes C20-01.. are SYNTHETIC. The approved form lists items without identifiers; codes exist only so responses, incidents and audit records can reference a row, and must never be printed on the exported form.
Generated by scripts/vaes-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph position.
Document control values are pre-printed constants on the approved form — not inputs, and never overlaid.
